senses.en: a person who plays the flute

example.en: The flautist performed a beautiful solo at the concert.
example.zh: 这位长笛演奏者在音乐会上演奏了一曲美妙的独奏。

senses.en: a thing that is not named or specified

example.en: I heard something strange last night.
example.zh: 昨晚我听到了奇怪的动静。

senses.en: a thing or person of some importance

example.en: She thinks she is really something.
example.zh: 她认为自己真的很了不起。

senses.en: to become or make something darker

example.en: The sky began to darken as the storm approached.
example.zh: 暴风雨来临前，天空开始暗下来。

senses.en: a weakness or ambiguity in a law or contract that allows people to avoid its requirements

example.en: Companies use a tax loophole to reduce their payments.
example.zh: 公司利用税收漏洞来减少缴税。

senses.en: a small opening in a wall, formerly used for shooting or observing

example.en: Soldiers fired arrows through the loopholes in the castle wall.
example.zh: 士兵们从城堡墙上的射击孔射出箭。

senses.en: an idea or feeling suggested by a word beyond its literal meaning

example.en: The word 'cheap' has a negative connotation.
example.zh: “cheap”这个词带有贬义内涵。

senses.en: the act of making a book, magazine, or other work available to the public

example.en: The publication of the new magazine was announced in May.
example.zh: 新杂志的出版于五月宣布。

senses.en: a book, magazine, or other printed work that has been published

example.en: This publication is available at the local library.
example.zh: 这份出版物可在当地图书馆获取。

senses.en: the act of making information known to the public

example.en: The publication of the results followed a formal review.
example.zh: 结果的公布是在正式审查之后进行的。

senses.en: at the beginning; at first

example.en: The project was initially delayed by bad weather.
example.zh: 这个项目最初因恶劣天气而延误。

senses.en: causing surprise or wonder; unexpected
senses.zh: 令人惊讶的；出人意料的

example.en: The test results were surprising to everyone.
example.zh: 考试结果让所有人都感到惊讶。

senses.en: one of the parts that something is divided into

example.en: The first section of the book explains the basic ideas.
example.zh: 这本书的第一部分解释基本概念。

senses.en: a separate part of an organization, place, or store

example.en: She found the book in the history section of the store.
example.zh: 她在书店的历史区找到了这本书。

senses.en: to divide something into sections

example.en: The teacher sectioned the long article into shorter parts for class.
example.zh: 老师把这篇长文章分成较短的几部分供课堂使用。

senses.en: connected with religion or religious ceremonies
senses.zh: 与宗教或宗教仪式有关的

example.en: She attends a religious ceremony every spring.
example.zh: 她每年春天参加一场宗教仪式。

senses.en: believing strongly in a god and taking part in worship

example.en: He is deeply religious and prays daily.
example.zh: 他非常虔诚，每天祈祷。

senses.en: a person who belongs to a religious order and has taken vows

example.en: The religious in the community follow vows of poverty and obedience.
example.zh: 该团体中的修士修女遵循贫穷与服从的誓愿。

senses.en: the second largest continent, located south of Europe and bordered by the Atlantic and Indian Oceans
senses.zh: 非洲；世界第二大洲，位于欧洲以南，西临大西洋，东临印度洋

example.en: Many visitors travel to Africa to see its wildlife.
example.zh: 许多游客前往非洲观赏野生动物。

senses.en: a formal meeting of a group or organization to do its business

example.en: The committee will hold a session on Monday.
example.zh: 委员会将于周一举行会议。

senses.en: a period of time used for a particular activity, such as a class or training
senses.zh: 一段时间；课程；培训时段

example.en: She attended a training session on safety.
example.zh: 她参加了一次安全培训。

senses.en: a period during which a user is connected to a computer system or website

example.en: The website ended your session after ten minutes.
example.zh: 网站在十分钟后结束了你的会话。

senses.en: to show that something is true or correct

example.en: The test results confirm that the water is safe.
example.zh: 测试结果证实水是安全的。

senses.en: to make an arrangement or appointment definite

example.en: Please call the hotel to confirm your booking.
example.zh: 请打电话给酒店确认您的预订。

senses.en: to give official approval to something

example.en: The committee confirmed the new policy.
example.zh: 委员会批准了新政策。

senses.en: in a serious, careful, or sincere way

example.en: She seriously considered the offer before replying.
example.zh: 她在回复前认真考虑了这项提议。

senses.en: to a great or severe degree

example.en: He was seriously injured in the accident.
example.zh: 他在事故中受了重伤。

senses.en: used to emphasize that something is true or important

example.en: I seriously need a break.
example.zh: 我真的需要休息。

senses.en: a number that can be divided by another number without a remainder

example.en: Twelve is a multiple of three.
example.zh: 十二是三的倍数。

senses.en: involving more than one person, thing, or part; many

example.en: The team faced multiple challenges during the project.
example.zh: 团队在项目期间面临多重挑战。

senses.en: a guided weapon, often rocket-powered, that carries explosives to a target
senses.zh: 一种通常由火箭推进、可制导并携带炸药飞向目标的武器；导弹

example.en: The ship launched a missile at the target.
example.zh: 舰船向目标发射了一枚导弹。

senses.en: an object thrown or projected as a weapon

example.en: The crowd threw stones and other missiles at the gate.
example.zh: 人群向大门投掷石块和其他投射物。

senses.en: to make a loud, high-pitched cry because of fear, pain, excitement or laughter

example.en: She shrieked when a spider dropped onto her shoulder.
example.zh: 一只蜘蛛落到她肩上时，她尖叫起来。

senses.en: a loud, sharp, high-pitched cry
senses.zh: 尖叫声；尖锐刺耳的声音

example.en: A shriek of alarm came from the next room.
example.zh: 隔壁房间传来一声惊恐的尖叫。

senses.en: to shake or move rapidly back and forth

example.en: The phone vibrated in her pocket.
example.zh: 手机在她口袋里振动了。

senses.en: to make something shake rapidly, often as an alert

example.en: Set your phone to vibrate during the meeting.
example.zh: 开会期间把手机设为震动。

senses.en: a written message sent quickly by telegraph

example.en: She received a telegram announcing her brother's arrival.
example.zh: 她收到一封通知她兄弟到达的电报。

senses.en: an alphabetical list of special terms with their meanings, often at the end of a book

example.en: The textbook includes a glossary of technical terms at the back.
example.zh: 这本教科书在书末附有专业术语表。

senses.en: Karl Marx (1818–1883), German philosopher and economist, founder of Marxism
senses.zh: 马克思（卡尔·马克思，德国哲学家、经济学家，马克思主义创始人）

example.en: Many students study the theories of Marx in university courses.
example.zh: 许多学生在大学课程中学习马克思的理论。

senses.en: a family name, also used for the Marx Brothers, the American comedy team
senses.zh: 马克斯（姓氏；也指美国喜剧组合“马克斯兄弟”）

example.en: The Marx Brothers made audiences laugh in classic films of the 1930s.
example.zh: 马克斯兄弟在二十世纪三十年代的经典电影中让观众捧腹大笑。

senses.en: made up of different kinds of things combined together

example.en: The salad has mixed vegetables and nuts.
example.zh: 这份沙拉有混合的蔬菜和坚果。

senses.en: involving or consisting of people of different races

example.en: She grew up in a mixed neighborhood.
example.zh: 她在一个多种族混居的社区长大。

senses.en: a long thin mark or line different in color from what surrounds it

example.en: There is a white streak on the cat's back.
example.zh: 那只猫的背上有一道白色条纹。

senses.en: an unbroken period of success, luck, or repeated events
senses.zh: 一连串；连续不断的时期

example.en: The team is on a winning streak.
example.zh: 这支球队正处于连胜中。

senses.en: a characteristic or element of someone's personality

example.en: She has a stubborn streak.
example.zh: 她有点固执的脾气。

senses.en: to move very fast in a straight line

example.en: A comet streaked across the sky.
example.zh: 一颗彗星划过天空。

senses.en: the fact of not being guilty of a crime or wrongdoing

example.en: The evidence proved her innocence.
example.zh: 证据证明了她的清白。

senses.en: lack of experience of evil; childlike purity

example.en: The child watched the world with wide-eyed innocence.
example.zh: 这孩子睁着天真的眼睛看着世界。

senses.en: an open public square in a city or town

example.en: Crowds gathered in the main plaza to watch the festival.
example.zh: 人们聚集在主广场观看节庆活动。

senses.en: a shopping center with stores and restaurants
senses.zh: 购物中心（尤指美式购物广场）

example.en: There's a new coffee shop in the plaza across the street.
example.zh: 街对面的购物中心新开了一家咖啡店。

senses.en: meat from an adult sheep, eaten as food

example.en: For dinner we had roasted mutton with vegetables.
example.zh: 晚餐我们吃了烤羊肉配蔬菜。

senses.en: a company or business that provides expert professional advice

example.en: She works for a management consultancy in London.
example.zh: 她在伦敦一家管理咨询公司工作。

senses.en: the work or practice of giving expert professional advice

example.en: He earns a good income from his IT consultancy.
example.zh: 他从他的IT咨询业务中获得了不错的收入。

senses.en: to make someone not satisfied or displeased

example.en: The poor service dissatisfied many customers.
example.zh: 糟糕的服务使许多顾客感到不满。

senses.en: the number 2; one more than one

example.en: She bought two apples at the store.
example.zh: 她在商店买了两个苹果。

senses.en: the digit or playing card marked with 2
senses.zh: 二（数字或牌面上的两点）

example.en: The two of hearts is in my hand.
example.zh: 红桃二在我手里。

senses.en: the act of taking part in an activity or event

example.en: Her involvement in the project made a big difference.
example.zh: 她参与这个项目起到了很大的作用。

senses.en: a connection or association with something, often something problematic

example.en: The report revealed his involvement in the scandal.
example.zh: 报告揭露了他与这起丑闻的牵连。

senses.en: a large pile of dried grass used as animal feed

example.en: Cows grazed in the field beside the tall haystack.
example.zh: 牛在高高的干草堆旁的田地里吃草。

collocations: like looking for a needle in a haystack

senses.en: having a row of sharp teeth or notches like a saw

example.en: The bread knife has a serrated edge that cuts crusts easily.
example.zh: 这把面包刀有锯齿状的刀刃，很容易切开面包皮。

senses.en: to place things side by side for comparison or contrast

example.en: The exhibit juxtaposes modern art with classical paintings.
example.zh: 这次展览将现代艺术与古典绘画并列展出。

senses.en: an insulting remark about a person or group

example.en: He was fired for making a racial slur.
example.zh: 他因发表种族侮辱言论而被解雇。

senses.en: to speak unclearly, with sounds running together

example.en: He was so tired that his words began to slur.
example.zh: 他累得说话都开始含糊不清了。

senses.en: a curved line in music showing that notes should be played smoothly

example.en: Play the notes under the slur smoothly.
example.zh: 连线下的音符要演奏得连贯流畅。

senses.en: a device that automatically controls temperature in a room or machine
senses.zh: 恒温器；温度自动调节器

example.en: Turn down the thermostat to save energy.
example.zh: 把恒温器调低以节约能源。

senses.en: to put something over another thing to protect or hide it

example.en: She covered the food with a cloth.
example.zh: 她用布把食物盖住了。

senses.en: something placed over or around an object to protect it, or the outside of a book

example.en: The book has a bright blue cover.
example.zh: 这本书有亮蓝色的封面。

senses.en: to include or deal with a subject

example.en: The course covers basic grammar.
example.zh: 这门课程涵盖基础语法。

senses.en: to provide enough money for a cost

example.en: The prize money covered the travel costs.
example.zh: 奖金支付了旅费。

senses.en: a business company

example.en: She works for a small law firm in Shanghai.
example.zh: 她在上海一家小型律师事务所工作。

senses.en: hard and solid, not soft

example.en: Make sure the ladder stands on firm ground.
example.zh: 确保梯子立在坚实的地面上。

senses.en: strong and not likely to change

example.en: The team has a firm belief in its plan.
example.zh: 团队对自己的计划有坚定的信念。

senses.en: to make something solid or secure

example.en: She firmed the soil around the young tree.
example.zh: 她把小树周围的土压实了。

senses.en: an empty area or room available for something

example.en: There is enough space for another chair.
example.zh: 还有足够的空间再放一把椅子。

senses.en: the region beyond Earth's atmosphere where stars and planets are found

example.en: The telescope sends back images from deep space.
example.zh: 这台望远镜从深空传回图像。

senses.en: to arrange things with distances between them

example.en: Space the plants about a foot apart.
example.zh: 把这些植物间隔约一英尺栽种。

senses.en: belonging to me

example.en: That book is mine, not yours.
example.zh: 那本书是我的，不是你的。

senses.en: a place where minerals are dug from the ground

example.en: The mine produces copper.
example.zh: 这座矿出产铜。

senses.en: to dig minerals or other materials out of the ground

example.en: They mine coal in this region.
example.zh: 他们在这个地区开采煤炭。

senses.en: a bomb hidden in the ground or water

example.en: The soldiers cleared the mine from the road.
example.zh: 士兵们清除了路上的地雷。

senses.en: the entry and growth of germs in the body, or an illness caused by them
senses.zh: 感染；病原体侵入并在体内生长繁殖，或由此引起的疾病

example.en: The cut became red and swollen from infection.
example.zh: 伤口因感染而变得红肿。

senses.en: the act or process of infecting someone or something

example.en: Hand washing helps prevent the infection of other patients.
example.zh: 洗手有助于防止其他患者受到感染。

senses.en: a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people
senses.zh: 消防员；灭火并救助他人的人

example.en: The firefighter carried a child out of the smoke.
example.zh: 那名消防员把一个孩子从烟雾中救了出来。

senses.en: strong and healthy; sturdy

example.en: He is a robust young man who rarely gets sick.
example.zh: 他是个健壮的年轻人，很少生病。

senses.en: strong and unlikely to fail, even in difficult conditions

example.en: The economy showed robust growth last year.
example.zh: 去年经济显示出强劲的增长。

senses.en: having a rich, full flavor

example.en: This coffee has a robust flavor.
example.zh: 这种咖啡味道浓郁。

senses.en: a flat paved outdoor area next to a house or restaurant where people can sit outside

example.en: We had breakfast on the hotel terrace overlooking the sea.
example.zh: 我们在旅馆可俯瞰大海的露台上吃早餐。

senses.en: one of a series of flat areas cut like steps into a hillside, often for farming

example.en: Rice grows well on the terraces cut into the hillside.
example.zh: 水稻在山坡开垦的梯田上长得很好。

senses.en: to form something into flat stepped levels, especially for growing crops
senses.zh: 使成梯田；把…修成梯级状

example.en: Farmers terraced the steep slope to plant vegetables.
example.zh: 农民把陡坡修成梯田来种植蔬菜。

senses.en: a shape like an egg, rounded and elongated

example.en: She drew an oval on the whiteboard.
example.zh: 她在白板上画了一个椭圆形。

senses.en: shaped like an egg; rounded and elongated

example.en: He has an oval face and dark hair.
example.zh: 他有一张椭圆形的脸和深色的头发。

senses.en: an excessive desire for more money or possessions than one needs

example.en: His greed led him to cheat his business partners.
example.zh: 他的贪婪使他欺骗了自己的生意伙伴。

senses.en: excessive desire for something such as food or power

example.en: He ate the whole cake out of sheer greed.
example.zh: 他纯粹因为贪嘴把整块蛋糕都吃了。

senses.en: the state of a species no longer existing

example.en: Many species face extinction because of habitat loss.
example.zh: 许多物种因栖息地丧失而面临灭绝。

senses.en: the act of putting an end to something, such as a fire or a practice

example.en: The complete extinction of the fire took several hours.
example.zh: 彻底扑灭大火花了好几个小时。

senses.en: to take turns or switch back and forth between two things or states

example.en: The class alternates between discussion and group work.
example.zh: 这门课在讨论和小组活动之间交替进行。

senses.en: happening every second one in a series; every other

example.en: We water the plants on alternate days.
example.zh: 我们每隔一天给植物浇水。

senses.en: a person who takes the place of another if needed

example.en: She is the first alternate on the team.
example.zh: 她是队里的第一替补。

senses.en: the hot mist that water turns into when it boils

example.en: Steam rose from the hot soup.
example.zh: 热汤冒着蒸汽。

senses.en: to cook food over boiling water rather than in oil or water

example.en: She likes to steam vegetables instead of boiling them.
example.zh: 她喜欢蒸蔬菜而不是煮蔬菜。

senses.en: to give off steam or rise as steam

example.en: The kettle was steaming on the stove.
example.zh: 水壶在炉子上冒着蒸汽。

senses.en: energy or force, as in getting work done (informal)

example.en: After a rest, he got up the steam to finish the project.
example.zh: 休息之后，他鼓起干劲完成这个项目。

senses.en: the practice of farming, including growing crops and raising animals

example.en: Agriculture employs most of the people in this region.
example.zh: 农业雇用了这个地区的大多数人。

senses.en: the scientific study of farming

example.en: She studied agriculture at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习农学。

senses.en: a very powerful tropical storm with strong winds and heavy rain

example.en: The hurricane destroyed many houses along the coast.
example.zh: 这场飓风摧毁了沿海的许多房屋。

senses.en: a period of time between two events or points in time

example.en: There is a ten-minute interval between the two classes.
example.zh: 两节课之间有十分钟的间隔。

senses.en: a short break between parts of a performance, game or activity (British English; also called intermission in American English)

example.en: The band came back on stage after the interval.
example.zh: 中场休息后乐队回到台上。

senses.en: the space or distance between two things; a range between two values or points

example.en: The numbers are grouped into intervals on the graph.
example.zh: 图表中的数字被分成了若干区间。

senses.en: to be disloyal to someone, especially by helping their enemies

example.en: He betrayed his country by selling secrets to the enemy.
example.zh: 他通过向敌人出卖情报背叛了自己的国家。

senses.en: to fail or disappoint someone who trusts you

example.en: She felt betrayed when her closest friend shared her secret.
example.zh: 当她最亲密的朋友泄露她的秘密时，她感到被辜负了。

senses.en: to reveal something unintentionally, often through signs or emotions

example.en: His trembling hands betrayed his nervousness.
example.zh: 他颤抖的双手暴露了他的紧张。

senses.en: to represent an idea or quality in a concrete or visible form

example.en: The new policy embodies the values of fairness and equality.
example.zh: 这项新政策体现了公平与平等的价值观。

senses.en: to include or contain something as part of a whole

example.en: The constitution embodies the fundamental rights of citizens.
example.zh: 这部宪法包含了公民的基本权利。

senses.en: a stop, especially a temporary one

example.en: The train came to a halt at the station.
example.zh: 火车在车站停了下来。

senses.en: to stop moving or make something stop

example.en: Police halted traffic during the parade.
example.zh: 警察在游行期间让交通停了下来。

senses.en: a command telling someone to stop

example.en: The guard shouted, 'Halt! Who goes there?'
example.zh: 卫兵喊道：“站住！什么人？”

senses.en: a statement expressing a judgment or opinion; in logic, a statement that is either true or false

example.en: The proposition that all humans are equal is widely accepted.
example.zh: 人人生而平等这一主张被广泛接受。

senses.en: an offer or plan suggested for acceptance

example.en: They made a business proposition to the company.
example.zh: 他们向那家公司提出了一个商业建议。

senses.en: to make a sexual suggestion or proposal to someone

example.en: She claimed that he had propositioned her after the party.
example.zh: 她声称他在聚会后向她提出了性要求。

senses.en: the chemical processes in a living organism that sustain life, including using energy and building or breaking down substances

example.en: The researchers studied the fish's metabolism.
example.zh: 研究人员研究了这种鱼的新陈代谢。

senses.en: soft and loose, especially body flesh lacking firmness

example.en: Regular exercise got rid of his flabby arms.
example.zh: 经常锻炼让他松弛的手臂结实起来。

senses.en: a sweater put on by pulling it over the head

example.en: She wore a warm wool pullover to the office.
example.zh: 她穿着一件暖和的羊毛套头毛衣去上班。

senses.en: a shout of praise to God; an expression of joy
senses.zh: 哈利路亚（赞美上帝的呼喊）

example.en: Hallelujah! The rain has finally stopped.
example.zh: 哈利路亚！雨终于停了。

senses.en: a song or shout praising God

example.en: The choir ended the concert with a joyful hallelujah.
example.zh: 唱诗班以欢快的哈利路亚结束了音乐会。

senses.en: the ability of a material to conduct heat or electricity

example.en: Copper has high electrical conductivity.
example.zh: 铜的导电性很高。

senses.en: a diaper worn by babies to catch excrement (British usage)

example.en: She changed the baby's nappy before putting him to bed.
example.zh: 她在哄宝宝睡觉前给他换了尿布。

senses.en: (of hair) tightly curled or kinky

example.en: She embraced her natural nappy hair.
example.zh: 她接受了自己天然的紧卷头发。

senses.en: relating to Scotland, its people, or its culture

example.en: He plays in a traditional Scots band.
example.zh: 他在一支传统苏格兰乐队演奏。

senses.en: the variety of English traditionally spoken in lowland Scotland
senses.zh: 苏格兰英语；苏格兰方言

example.en: Many poems by Robert Burns are written in Scots.
example.zh: 罗伯特·彭斯的许多诗是用苏格兰语写的。

senses.en: a carbohydrate found in foods like potatoes, rice and bread

example.en: Rice is rich in starch.
example.zh: 大米富含淀粉。

senses.en: a substance used to make clothes stiff

example.en: She sprayed some starch on the collar before ironing it.
example.zh: 她在熨烫领口前喷了些浆粉。

senses.en: to stiffen fabric with starch

example.en: He asked the cleaner to starch his shirts.
example.zh: 他请洗衣店给他的衬衫上浆。

senses.en: easily annoyed or made angry

example.en: Lack of sleep makes him irritable.
example.zh: 睡眠不足让他易怒。

senses.en: absolute, without exceptions or doubts
senses.zh: 断然的；绝对的；明确无疑的

example.en: She gave a categorical refusal to the offer.
example.zh: 她断然拒绝了这个提议。

senses.en: relating to categories or classification

example.en: The data was organized into categorical groups.
example.zh: 这些数据被归入不同的类别组。

senses.en: having many different types or parts

example.en: The company has a diversified portfolio of investments.
example.zh: 这家公司拥有多元化的投资组合。

senses.en: a sudden or noticeable decrease in amount or quality

example.en: There has been a drop-off in sales this month.
example.zh: 本月销售额有所下降。

senses.en: a steep downward slope or cliff

example.en: The road runs along a dangerous drop-off.
example.zh: 这条路沿着一段危险的陡崖。

senses.en: ways of doing something, especially systematic and orderly ways

example.en: The teacher uses new methods to make classes more interesting.
example.zh: 这位老师用新方法让课堂更有趣。
